question:
If 29 A 17 B 20 = 32 and 33 A 14 B 10 = 29, then what will be 11 A 8 B 3 = ?

यदि 29 A 17 B 20 = 32 और 33 A 14 B 10 = 29 हो, तो 11 A 8 B 3 = कितना होगा?
solution_text:
Equation I

29 A 17 B 20 = 32

Let A = - ; B = +

29 - 17 + 20 = 32

32 = 32

Equation II

33 A 14 B 10 = 29

33 - 14 + 10 = 29

29 = 29

इसी प्रकार,

11 A 8 B 3

11 - 8 + 3

14 – 8

= 6
